name: Red Jack Flint
summary: In Menethil Keep, Red Jack Flint connects sailors with travelers bound across the sea. He is a seasoned human mariner and crew member of the Maiden's Virtue, helping travelers find passage and contacts toward Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Sailor in Menethil Keep
sections.body: Red Jack Flint is a seasoned sailor in Menethil Keep. A crewman of the Maiden's Virtue, he knows the sea routes from Khaz Modan to distant shores. He also directs capable travelers to allies across the Great Sea, including Fiora Longears in Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Red Jack Flint is a human sailor aboard the Maiden's Virtue. From Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor, he helps travelers connect with contacts across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

faq.q: Where can Red Jack Flint be found?
faq.answer: Red Jack Flint can be found inside Menethil Keep, the stone fortress defending Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

faq.q: What ship does Red Jack Flint sail on?
aliases: what ship is red jack on
faq.answer: Red Jack Flint serves aboard the Maiden's Virtue, a merchant vessel sailing from Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Who does Red Jack Flint send travelers to see?
faq.answer: Red Jack Flint directs travelers to Fiora Longears, his partner across the sea in the port of Theramore.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler sailing from Khaz Modan, you can rely on sailors like Red Jack Flint to connect you with outposts along Kalimdor's northern coast.
